title: `LimitedSet` : a re-added item still expires or is evicted based on its old timestamp

title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.  For example, with `TIME_ZONE = "Asia/Jakarta"`, a cron expression intended to run at `08:25` is scheduled for `08:25 UTC` and therefore runs at `15:25` Jakarta time.  ## Environment  - django-rq: 4.2.0 - rq: 2.12.0 - Django `TIME_ZONE`: `Asia/Jakarta` - Djan...
